MOBIB Extractor project databases (Database/Metro.csv, Database/Bus.csv)
Bundled, converted form: src/contactless/ERD.Card.MOBIB.Brussels.pas
Source: https://github.com/zoobab/mobib-extractor

(c) 2009 MOBIB Extractor project. This software is provided 'as-is',
without any express or implied warranty. In no event will the authors be held
liable for any damages arising from the use of this software.

Permission is granted to anyone to use this software for any purpose,
including commercial applications, and to alter it and redistribute it
freely, subject to no restriction.

Changes made for this repository: map coordinates were omitted, binary keys
were converted to integers, the 442 bus rows whose stop code exceeds the
twelve-bit event field were dropped, and non-ASCII characters are stored as \uXXXX
escapes that the lookup unit decodes at run time.
